raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Reject multimodal embedding requests when enable_chunked_processing is enabled, instead of silently dropping their multimodal data. Return HTTP 400 with guidance to disable chunked processing.

## Claims

- Reject multimodal inputs, including short inputs, before chunk expansion or inference submission.
- Preserve text-only chunked processing and multimodal requests with chunked processing disabled.

## Validation

uv run --no-sync .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/entrypoints/pooling/embed/test_io_processor.py \
  tests/entrypoints/pooling/embed/test_protocol.py -q

72 tests passed. Added coverage for short and long multimodal inputs in mixed batches, plus the disabled-setting case. Applicable pre-commit checks passed.

Real HTTP validation used google/siglip-base-patch16-224 on an H800, BF16, eager mode, max_model_len=64, and max_num_seqs=1:

- With chunking enabled, image requests through /v2/embed and mixed text/image batches through /v1/embeddings returned HTTP 400. Subsequent text requests succeeded.
- With chunking disabled, image and mixed-batch requests succeeded; red and blue images produced different embeddings.
- A 217-token text input was split into four chunks. Its aggregated embedding matched the independently computed weighted, normalized reference within a maximum absolute difference of 3.31e-8.

## Details

maybe_pre_process_chunked() rebuilds inputs using tokens_input(), which discards multimodal payloads, hashes, and placeholders, even when the input fits in a single chunk.

This change validates the entire batch before rewriting inputs, preventing silent multimodal data loss when chunked processing is enabled.

</details>

files.patch:
@@ -21,7 +21,9 @@
     PoolingEngineInput,
     PoolingServeContext,
 )
-from vllm.inputs import tokens_input
+from vllm.exceptions import VLLMValidationError
+from vllm.inputs import mm_input, tokens_input
+from vllm.multimodal.inputs import MultiModalKwargsItems, PlaceholderRange
 from vllm.outputs import PoolingOutput, PoolingRequestOutput
 
 
@@ -463,6 +465,33 @@ def _make_output(
             finished=True,
         )
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        ("chunking_enabled", "num_tokens"), [(True, 2), (True, 5), (False, 2)]
+    )
+    def test_multimodal_input_requires_chunking_disabled(
+        self, chunking_enabled, num_tokens
+    ):
+        """Reject images before changing a mixed batch, including short inputs."""
+        handler = self._make_handler()
+        handler.enable_chunked_processing = chunking_enabled
+        ctx = self._make_context()
+        assert ctx.engine_inputs is not None
+        image_prompt = mm_input(
+            prompt_token_ids=list(range(num_tokens)),
+            mm_kwargs=MultiModalKwargsItems({"image": [None]}),
+            mm_hashes={"image": ["cached-image"]},
+            mm_placeholders={"image": [PlaceholderRange(offset=0, length=1)]},
+        )
+        ctx.engine_inputs[1]["prompts"] = image_prompt
+
+        if chunking_enabled:
+            with pytest.raises(VLLMValidationError, match="multimodal inputs"):
+                handler.maybe_pre_process_chunked(ctx)
+        else:
+            handler.maybe_pre_process_chunked(ctx)
+        assert ctx.engine_inputs[1]["prompts"] is image_prompt
+        assert ctx.original_engine_inputs is None
+
     def test_aggregation_uses_metadata_not_request_id_parsing(self):
         handler = self._make_handler()
         ctx = self._make_context()

@@ -83,7 +83,7 @@ class PoolerConfig:
     maximum position embeddings. When enabled, long inputs will be split into
     chunks, processed separately, and then aggregated using weighted averaging.
     This allows embedding models to handle arbitrarily long text without CUDA
-    errors. Defaults to False.
+    errors. Multimodal inputs are not supported. Defaults to False.
     """
     max_embed_len: int | None = None
     """

@@ -136,6 +136,15 @@ def maybe_pre_process_chunked(self, ctx: PoolingServeContext) -> None:
         if ctx.engine_inputs is None:
             raise ValueError("Engine prompts not available")
 
+        if any(
+            engine_input["prompts"]["type"] == "multimodal"
+            for engine_input in ctx.engine_inputs
+        ):
+            raise VLLMValidationError(
+                "Chunked embedding processing does not support multimodal inputs. "
+                "Disable enable_chunked_processing to use multimodal inputs."
+            )
+
         ctx.original_engine_inputs = ctx.engine_inputs
         request_id = ctx.request_id
         max_model_len = self.model_config.max_model_len
